threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused at the bus stops when they come late. Locals just check their phones and carry on like it’s part of the charm.
Caught the 36 last night; two blokes in matching tracksuits debating the best chicken shop in Peckham all the way to Clapham. Pure local rivalry.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw my neighbor fixing his bike on the sidewalk with a cat perched on his shoulder and a loud debate about soccer in the background.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do we have Kiosks selling everything from currywurst to craft beer at 3 AM, while the U-Bahn is still on strike.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot the locals by their calm in BART delays; it’s like we’re all in on the joke while newcomers panic over a loud bang.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Only in SF do you witness a dog casually saunter onto the Civic Center tracks, causing an hour delay, while locals shrug and snap photos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think we all party until dawn. Meanwhile, most locals are at home by 11, enjoying a quiet night after a long day.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always stand in front of the Cathedral with a guidebook, taking photos of every statue like it's a once-in-a-lifetime moment.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep calling it a 'corner shop' instead of the local 'offie.' It's the little things, like not knowing where to find the best patisserie yet.
Last week on the 196, a bloke tried to pay with a potato. The driver just shook his head and kept driving – only in Brixton, eh?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group setting up a pop-up café in a vacant lot, complete with fairy lights and an open mic. That's Neukölln, always creating something from nothing.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find spontaneous rooftop parties with locals grilling and jamming, while the sun sets over the graffiti-ed murals.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re local if they ask for pupusas at the taqueria but still check the BART schedule for delays before heading out.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught Muni at Civic Center today, and some dude was proposing to his girlfriend right on the platform. Not even the delays could dampen that moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the parks and Gaudí, but they miss the hidden plazas where locals gossip over cerveses, especially on quiet afternoons.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by the way they nervously order tapas, insisting on how they want the 'patatas bravas'—it’s always a dead giveaway.
